t: Francesco Grimaldi captured the fortress on the Rock of Monaco in 1297 with his men disguised as Franciscan friars; after a century of feud with Genoa the family bought Monaco outright from the Crown of Aragon in 1419, and Honoré II styled himself Prince in 1612.

In 1861 Charles III ceded Menton and Roquebrune, some 95% of the principality's territory, to France for 4,100,000 francs in exchange for recognition of Monaco's sovereignty; the Monte Carlo casino paid so well that income tax was abolished in 1869.

Monaco has the world's highest nominal GDP per head (US$185,742), 31% of its residents are millionaires, and fewer than 10,000 of its 38,423 inhabitants are Monégasque; France still provides its defence, and in June 2024 the FATF put it under increased monitoring for money laundering.
dyk: Monégasque citizens are forbidden to enter the Monte Carlo casino unless they work there, a rule decreed so as not to overtax them; by 1869 the casino's earnings let the principality stop collecting income tax from its citizens altogether, a policy that still stands.
ev: Francesco Grimaldi, 'Malizia', and his men dressed as Franciscan friars capture the fortress protecting the Rock of Monaco.
The Grimaldi family purchases Monaco from the Crown of Aragon and becomes its official and undisputed ruler.
Honoré II begins to style himself Prince of Monaco; Spain recognises his sovereignty in 1633 and Louis XIII of France by the Treaty of Péronne in 1641.
Revolutionary French forces capture Monaco, which remains occupied and annexed until the Grimaldi are restored in 1814.
The Franco-Monégasque Treaty recognises Monaco's sovereignty; Charles III cedes Menton and Roquebrune to France for 4,100,000 francs.
Flush with the casino's earnings, the principality stops collecting income tax from its residents.
The Monégasque Revolution of 1910 forces the first constitution on the hitherto absolute princes.
Monaco becomes a member of the United Nations with full voting rights.

f.founder: Francesco Grimaldi, 'Malizia', who seized the fortress in 1297; the Grimaldi became undisputed rulers by purchase from Aragon in 1419
f.predecessor: The Genoese colony of Monaco, refounded in 1215 on land granted by Emperor Henry VI in 1191
